content.title: 2026 Masters Sunday channel: TV schedule for Round 4 at Augusta National
content.text: Find out how to watch Sunday's final round of the 2026 Masters below. Ben Jared/PGA TOUR via Getty Images The 2026 Masters hits the final round on Sunday at Augusta National. CBS will air TV coverage of all the final-round play, and there are numerous other ways to watch as well. Keep reading for a complete 2026 Masters Sunday TV schedule and streaming information.What channel is Masters Round 4 on?CBS will be the only TV channel carrying Sunday’s final round of the Masters. CBS’ Masters Sunday broadcast begins at 2 p.m. ET and runs for five hours until 7 p.m. ET. The Masters final-round coverage online is far more extensive.As they did last year, Paramount+ will provide two hours of early Saturday streaming coverage beginning at 12 p.m. ET. You can also watch the early coverage and CBS’ broadcast for free on Masters.com and the Masters App from 12-7 p.m. ET.Additional online viewing options will be provided via Masters.com, the Masters App, Paramount+, the ESPN App and more, including featured group and featured hole coverage.Below you will find more detailed information on how to watch the final round of the 2026 Masters.Masters
